name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Without Auth)
description: Enables deployment of a remote Model Context Protocol server on Cloudflare Workers without authentication. Allows custom tool definitions and connection from MCP clients like Claude Desktop or Cloudflare AI Playground.
